paper.title_en: Quantum Noise-Limited Terahertz Interferometry for Distinguishing Ultra-Compact Supermassive Galactic Objects
paper.abstract_en: The images of the galactic centers, M87$^*$ and Sgr~A$^*$, obtained by the Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) provide hitherto unknown revelations on these supermassive objects. The key issue here is the presence or otherwise of an event horizon at these ultra-compact entities. We show here that distinguishing the central images generated by gravitational lensing of a Schwarzschild black hole and a Joshi--Malafarina--Narayan (JMN-1) central naked singularity provides important insights into the nature of these supermassive objects and would help test the cosmic censorship conjecture, central to black hole physics. For optically thin spherical accretion onto Sgr~A$^*$, their interferometric visibilities become separable, independently of the emission model, on three baseline ranges within 1.4--6.2 G$λ$ at errors of $\simeq36\,μ$Jy, and at $L_\star=2.64\,$G$λ$ at $\simeq71\,μ$Jy. This is about 28 times below the 2017 Event Horizon Telescope statistical uncertainty. We suggest that the widest detection window demands minutes-long coherent integrations, favoring a near-quantum-limited space interferometer.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文聚焦于区分黑洞视界与裸奇点（JMN-1）的干涉观测特征，直接关联宇宙监督假设这一广义相对论基础问题，并给出具体的基线范围与噪声量级估计，主题明确、可读性较好；适合作为广义相对论基础方向候选进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 用于区分超致密超大质量天体对象的量子噪声受限太赫兹干涉测量
decision.abstract_zh: 事件视界望远镜（EHT）获得的星系中心 M87$^*$ 与 Sgr~A$^*$ 图像，为这些超大质量对象提供了此前未知的启示。这里的关键问题在于这些超致密实体是否存在事件视界。我们在此表明，区分由 Schwarzschild 黑洞与 Joshi--Malafarina--Narayan（JMN-1）中心裸奇点的引力透镜效应所产生的中心图像，可为这些超大质量对象的性质提供重要洞见，并有助于检验宇宙监督假设——该假设是黑洞物理的核心。对于 Sgr~A$^*$ 上的光学薄球对称吸积，它们的干涉可见度在 1.4--6.2 G$\lambda$ 范围内的三段基线上、在约 $\simeq36\,\mu$Jy 的误差水平下，以及在 $L_\star=2.64\,$G$\lambda$ 处、约 $\simeq71\,\mu$Jy 的水平下，变得可以区分，且与发射模型无关。这大约比 2017 年事件视界望远镜的统计不确定度低 28 倍。我们提出，最宽的探测窗口需要分钟量级的相干积分，这有利于接近量子极限的空间干涉仪。
